node.title: Car Evolution Mobility OS – Evidence Cases 03-07
node.reading:
Case 03 · Tallinn old town edge · access window 07:30–09:30 · policy as a number Source: POLITICA_CHOICES +3 to N, POLITICA_TRANSBORDOS_CHOICES CT DIN FO LO NT NP, valor_politicas , valor_puntualidad , valor_ocupacion , valor_ahorro_unidades

The policy scale is not a switch. It runs from +3 to −5 , and it is asymmetric on purpose: the penalty for an option we want avoided is heavier than the reward for one we prefer. That is how a city reasons about restriction, and it was in the constants a decade ago.

Every point carries its own transfer policy, including one that is not a pickup point at all. Toompea is refused, and the refusal is a policy value rather than an omission.

Two weightings are scored side by side and the authority takes B. Punctuality falls from 0.91 to 0.78. The cost is recorded next to the choice , because the decision has to survive being asked about in public, and a decision whose price was never written down cannot.

relations: An operator-led walkthrough could make the judgment behind the exhibit teachable without pretending the interface contains all tacit knowledge.
Un screencast no captura todo el juicio tácito ni convierte una reconstrucción en evidencia de una operación nueva.
The policy exhibits should be read with their evidence labels and the historical scenario-governance mechanism.
El propio exhibit distingue reconstrucción histórica y PoC. No convertir su localización ilustrativa ni sus números en un despliegue nuevo o resultado general.
The mobility exhibits could seed constructed counterexamples that test the interaction of locally valid policies.
No describir el escenario como incidente real en Tallinn, Barcelona o un cliente. El escenario EA también es construido y exige condiciones comunes explícitas.
A planned write-back may need requalification when its policy, capacity or resource-state conditions change before execution.
Los exhibits distinguen reconstrucción histórica y PoC; la propuesta no convierte todos los checks en funciones históricas desplegadas.
